description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the JobTitleDao class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It tests methods related to retrieving, deleting, and counting job title entities, using fixtures for setup.

classes.name: JobTitleDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for the JobTitleDao class, verifying data retrieval, deletion, and filter functions within the HR management system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO object and loads fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleList
methods.description: Verifies that the DAO correctly retrieves a list of job titles.

methods.name: testGetJobTitlesForEmployee
methods.description: Checks that job titles assigned to specific employees are correctly fetched.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleListWithInactiveJobTitles
methods.description: Tests retrieval of job titles including inactive ones.

methods.name: testDeleteJobTitle
methods.description: Tests the deletion of specified job titles.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleById
methods.description: Verifies fetching a job title by its ID.

methods.name: testGetJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of job specification attachments by ID.

methods.name: testGetJobTitles
methods.description: Tests retrieving job titles with filtering options.

methods.name: testGetJobTitlesCount
methods.description: Checks the count of job titles with and without filters.
